subject.title: fix(cli): run remote node commands through bundled MCP

question: Should this security-sensitive remote-exec surface merge without an after-fix live selected-node run?
rationale: The patch and automated coverage are strong, but repository policy requires observed after-fix behavior for an external non-docs PR.

options.title: Require live selected-node proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal or live output shows the command ran on the intended connected node.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the exact-head automated validation as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Require live selected-node proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal or live output shows the command ran on the intended connected node.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows direct ownership of the affected MCP, CLI preparation, and exec revocation paths.
